creativeThesis: Witness a body plan dismantle and develop anew, with one attached origin connecting its extraordinary stages.
viewerExperience: Close bell and moving tentacles in deep water; descend with regressing adult onto textured substrate, push into an organic connected tissue patch, pull back to the same cyst and follow stolon growth into polyps, then leave with a new medusa rising toward the opening light.
emotionalTarget: Wonder becomes understanding, then a sharper appreciation of living fragility.
visualThesis: A large translucent species-informed medusa becomes folded tissue, an attached cyst, a growing stolon and hydroid colony; deliberate macro views make each consequential change visible.
